policy: Only interior frame profiles determine shared per-set/material x/y scale and shift. Frozen scan-only poses; original calibration cohort only; reused validation. Opaque source support exactly excludes art contribution. Art aperture comes from pinned source alpha. Land groups are measured separately. Outer stock must be checked independently in actual-painter replay. These are proposals, not adopted defaults.
metrics: Gradient-profile correlations on opaque source-frame support, not whole-card scores. Modelled frame transformations require actual Canvas painting, art-window, color-binding, border and full-card verification.
landDecision: Keep the existing land renderer while independently fitting its art and rules borders. A whole-frame transform improves the mean but harms specific boundaries: Beta dual paper-top, Beta basic art-right/paper sides, and Unlimited dual art-bottom. Do not ship those pooled transforms.
